scope: Requested large Settings drag repair and affected shared control/feature/Snap checks only. Broad qualification remains paused.
investigation_limit_override: User explicitly permitted exceeding the two-cycle/30-minute limit on 2026-10-18.
input_method: Native macOS CUA; read-only matched MCP inspection/capture and saved-file comparison. No MCP mutations, input replay or modeling scripts.

ui_cases.expected: Large and repeated title movements track the press origin without losing ownership.
ui_cases.actual: Full 300-pixel left move; repeated left clamp; large diagonal to right/bottom; return to top. After reopening, repeat left/edge/diagonal also passes. No dismissal, reverse movement or unintended setting change.

ui_cases.expected: Resize a translated Settings dialog to its minimum and enlarge it again.
ui_cases.actual: Formerly failing corner gesture now reaches 400×260 at (172,8); subsequent enlargement reaches 600×460. Title, footer and resize handle stay accessible.

ui_cases.expected: Slider and button release semantics survive dialog movement and resizing.
ui_cases.actual: Slider changes 1.5 to 2.4. Dragging Reset outside before release leaves 2.4; a separate Reset click restores 1.5.

ui_cases.expected: Reach final settings above the fixed footer after resizing.
ui_cases.actual: Wheel reveals language/scale, GPU stock removal and document units; previous enabled and more disabled at the bottom.

ui_cases.expected: Standard scale radio and large title drag work at 125%.
ui_cases.actual: 125% radio selects and retains focus; large left title drag clamps near (8,8). Restoring 100% preserves controls and slider default.

ui_cases.expected: Production Tab/Shift+Tab and keyboard close work after geometry changes.
ui_cases.actual: Tab enters Close settings, then System; Shift+Tab returns to Close settings. Enter closes; File/Settings restores centered 480×700 geometry.

ui_cases.expected: Shared feature form keeps draft, dropdown and cancellation after a large move and resize.
ui_cases.actual: 14 mm draft survives a 600-pixel title translation and corner resize. Scrolling reveals lower fields. Extent opens and Escape restores trigger focus without changing Distance. Cancel and reopen confirms 12 mm.

ui_cases.expected: Apply once from the moved form and preserve undo/redo model semantics.
ui_cases.actual: Saved applied model differs only in distance 12→14. Undo saved model is byte-identical to input; Redo saved model matches applied model. Restored 12 afterward.

ui_cases.expected: Snap click/Space and production forward/reverse traversal retain focus.
ui_cases.actual: Click changes true→false and retains Snap binding; Space restores true. Tab goes to Constraint 2: horizontal in existing spatial order; Shift+Tab returns to Snap. Finish Sketch preserves the body/history.

ui_cases.expected: Save and reopen the restored test document without model changes.
ui_cases.actual: Saved model.json is byte-identical to input, including Snap=true. Native file picker reopens a fresh session with Body1, Sketch1 and Extrude1.

source_checks.clippy: strict release app and bevy_winit --lib --tests -- -D warnings passed

repairs: Vendored Bevy dialog records the press origin on PointerPress, retaining its existing drag state, picking, capture, translation and clamp. Other 14 upstream widget source files are byte-identical.

Opt-in primary-button boundary updates in the existing vendored Bevy window runner process pending motion, then the button transition, before later motion. Existing schedules and picking remain responsible; no custom hit test, input queue, gesture recognizer or timer.

investigation.intermediate_result: Origin-only V14 passes large title/edge movement but still has intermittent corner misses/language changes. V15 trace proves batched title press targeting the backdrop. These are retained failures, not final passes.
investigation.temporary_diagnostics: Both diagnostic commits are retained locally on diagnostic branches; no tracing is in final product source.

gif_format: Labeled native step captures, not real-time recordings. Review assets are crops/resizes with captions; raw PNG hashes are retained in receipts.
observations: The feature form retains its existing translucent body: ribbon text can show behind it when moved across the ribbon. Required controls remained readable and usable; this change does not alter its painter.
Immediate CUA screenshots sometimes preceded the settled frame. Acceptance and next coordinates use matched submitted native captures.
First V16 launch selection timed out after about 460 seconds; inventory showed it running and selecting by bundle ID succeeded immediately. No locked-Mac claim is made.
limits: Adds bounded App schedule work at primary-button transitions. Runner tests verify no idle polling; no zero-cost or broad performance claim.
Other platforms, host-window resize, every tool/form, full tab order, screen readers and IME edge cases remain outside this focused run.
No product copy changes; English/light and 100%/125% are the current native scope. Prior locale/theme results retain their original revision identities.
MCP mutations tested: zero. Broad UI/MCP ledger stays paused and unchanged. PR remains draft and experimental-ui-widgets opt-in.
